title: New Releases: Hero Character Generator 2 for MZ , MGC Animations Collection Vol 3

posts.author: RPGMakerWeb
posts.body:
More character generator parts! More particle animations! Check out our two new packs for MZ!
​
Give your hero a cute pet, a new haircut, and a powerful sci-fi spacesuit with the Hero Character Generator 2 for MZ pack! Gee-kun-soft is back with another set of MZ generator parts for your male characters, this time offering up 51 parts to choose from. 7 AccA, 6 AccB, 1 Cloak, 20 Clothing, 5 Eyes, 2 Facial Mark, 5 Front Hair, and 5 Rear Hair parts are ready to add some much-needed helmets to your sci-fi games and some important fantasy accessories that every game has been lacking: pets! Give your gruff and buff fighter some new armor and an adorable cat-like critter that hangs off his shoulder to let players know that he’s not as mean as he looks. Or reward your hero with a blue alien doggo for completing a tough side quest, so while he runs around space stations with his purple helmet and matching spacesuit he also has a cute companion!
Give your military party member some dress whites and matching hat when he needs to meet with important officers, and let your healer wear an extravagant gilded robe to help distract from his eyepatch. Show that an NPC has a punk attitude with some two-tone hair, or give them glaring eyes to make it seem like they’re always in a bad mood. Pick up the Hero Character Generator 2 for MZ pack and give your heroes some gorgeous new outfits and recognizable accessories so your players can easily find the character they’re looking for!

​
Buff your heroes and your battles with the MGC Animations Collection Vol 3! ManuGamingCreations is back with another set of Effekseer animations for MZ to add some extra flair to your skills. Power up your paladins with glowing swords, make it easy for your players to tell what element resistance is being put on their party members with different casting animations, burn enemies with roaring flames, and more with this pack!
76 animations are split into 9 different sections to make it easy to find what you want. 8 casting types, 13 flames, 5 holy sword moves, 7 cero blasts, and 13 runes and spells offer up a bunch of options to power up your mages’ skill sets and add some interesting buff/debuff animations to all your party members. And if that wasn’t enough, there are also more random animations in the variety and RPG sections: 14 in variety #1 that include sci-fi blasts and explosions in various colors, 5 in variety #2 that include dark X-shaped attacks, 8 in RPG #1 with purple moves that drain the target before exploding, and 3 in RPG #2 that include a fire attack that pours lava over its target!
This pack also includes an MZ project so you can see how each animation can work with the default sounds, or copy-paste them into your game to quickly add new moves to your battles. If you’ve been wanting to upgrade your different spells or need to annihilate enemies with overwhelming explosions, check out the MGC Animations Collection Vol 3!
